title: Profile
text: Operations specialist turned automation developer. Builds workflows that connect the tools a small team already uses, so information is entered once and moves on by itself.

title: Workflow automation
text: n8n, sub-workflows, error handling, webhooks, scheduled jobs.

title: Integrations
text: Gmail, Google Sheets, Shopify, WordPress, OpenAI.

title: Order follow-up for an online shop
text: Built an automation that sends customers a shipping update when an order leaves the warehouse and alerts the team when a delivery is late. It replaced a daily manual check of every open order.

title: Operations coordinator, Example Logistics
text: Coordinated daily deliveries for a team of twelve drivers. Introduced shared spreadsheets and checklists that cut missed deliveries.
